## MSFT valuation screens modestly undervalued on GF Value; outlets differ on magnitude

Both screens lean directionally favorable but from different frameworks and differing conclusions — useful background data point but insufficient on its own to support a position change without a business catalyst.

- GuruFocus flags MSFT as approximately 12.9% undervalued on its proprietary GF Value framework — figure is in the headline.
- Simplywall.st characterizes the stock as fairly valued on price but notes earnings suggest undervaluation.
- The two outlets diverge: one sees current undervaluation, the other sees valuation as fair with an earnings-based caveat.
- Low classifier confidence; routine valuation snapshot with no underlying business catalyst.
